searchText: https://forkcast.org/calls/focil/038 Regarding the [requirement](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/paris.md?plain=1#L135) in Paris we discussed, the reason we have it is to provide this property: whenever CL requests a payload, EL always respond, even with an empty one. cc <@741651225576996935> Thanks for sharing knowledge <@425572898787426305> As to the suggestion to considering changing it to return a payload with all valid IL transactions instead of an empty payload, it's technically feasible, but the complexity is probably not going to worth it IMHO. Besu now builds the block composed only of the valid IL transactions in place of the block with no txs, that should acceptable even if the spec does not change. we may change the spec, but it says SHOULD, it's recommended but not obligatory

Thanks for sharing knowledge <@425572898787426305>
